notes.title: Release 1.2
notes.content: I've added seven new levels created for daily singing practice: scales, triads, intervals. I've also added a button to end the level and another button to skip the ongoing music hints.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Sound hint improvements
notes.content: I redesigned the sound hint so that the melodies are now in rhythm. It's better for understanding the melody and remembering what you have to sing. I also changed the sound of the choir to the sound of a piano (upon request). Finally, on Maestro difficulty, I added a sound hint of the first tone. If you have any suggestion or question meet me at Discord.
